description: Sailing captain EXP requirements for all owned and shop captains, and raw captain EXP per trip for every island.
target: Sailing captain EXP requirements and island captain EXP per trip

extractions.label: captain_exp_requirements
extractions.description: Native next-level EXP requirements for owned captain indices 0–19 and displayed shop captain indices 30–33 in the genuine save. Each index maps to Captain.getExpForNextLevel().

extractions.label: island_captain_exp_per_trip
extractions.description: Raw captain EXP per trip for all 17 island indices. The native getter multiplies IslandInfo[index][8] by the account captain EXP multiplier. Compare Island.getCaptainExpPerTrip() without rounding or display conversion.
